items.note: S1.1 states Lemma lem:scalar-motifs (y_S -> y_S + x_S for arbitrary scratch values; stage 1 forward, stage 2 inverse, stage 3 forward give (X_a,Y_a) -> (-Y_a,X_a) with scratch restored) and S1.1.1-S1.1.5 follow the proof at 741-765 step by step (old scratch cancelled by rows 0-1, net (JV+RG)x, central coefficients |S cap T| mod 2 and (|S cap T|-1)/2, the three-stage composition). The neighbour counts and wire counts W_b, W_c (767-783) are not given, and h=100 never appears.

Frames D_v shared by every incidence of a gate, edge operator D_v D_u^{-1}, the invariant from sources through gates to sinks, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} on auxiliary roles too. This is exactly the paper's argument at 804-825.

The plan states nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3} of dimension m built from triple indicators, nesting on every edge, the central 3->4 edges as the only decreases (loss h), L=Ich, the budget Wm-2N+2L and L/N=100/539, 101/539. It gives the stage transitions, the interstage fit, the side-wire inclusion and the telescoping/terminal-sum count. It only points to the gate-label table eq:motif-labels and the edge residual table (975-990, 1021-1043), and it never gives the central gates' labels: A tensor F on the X bank, B tensor F on the Y bank (954-958). That assignment is what confines the loss to P tensor F on the 3->4 return, so the key monotonicity claim is asserted rather than shown.

Projections P_U at gates and sinks, -P_{U_a} at X_a sources, rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, the exceptional first edge 2P_{U_a} of rank one, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0, and the endpoint differences I_m on every role. These match the proof at 1156-1171. The resulting shear H<-H+D on every role through the frames Phi_M is given in S2.2.3-S2.2.4.

The kernel-per-orthonormal-residual-vector statement, s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m and C^{tensor m} on every role are stated, but the phase frame C_U=H^{tensor m} diag(i^{wt(P_U x) mod 4}) H^{tensor m} and the constants a=(1+i)/2, b=(1-i)/2 are never defined. S1.6.1-S1.6.3 only restate the proposition. The proof's core is missing: weight additivity mod 4 for orthogonal vectors, giving q_V-q_U as a sum over the residual basis, and the Hadamard conjugation of the character (-1)^{v.x} into the translation X_v (1232-1257). The orthonormal-basis fact and the Z-conjugation repair of the X_a->Y_a pair (1290-1310) are present.

The plan states s_b<W_b m, s_c<W_c m and L<N/2 from the exact loss ratios, and follows the paper's route from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 to s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. It never gives the exact relative deficits eta_b=339/22587335000000 and eta_c=73/19906842167500 (1321-1324), only that they exceed 20*2^{-50}.

The plan invokes 'the controlled shifts lemma' for linear-cost triangular updates and uses the cyclic row split and whole-chunk cyclic shifts. It never states Lemma lem:elementary-streams or lem:ordered-affine-streams with their content (O(V) for digit moves/splits/row splits, or y -> y+a(controls) mod q^b when the offset costs b^{O(1)}).

Factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 by topmost-row/rightmost-entry pivoting, triangular transforms in O(V) via controlled shifts, the sandwich order, and one interchange per one of Pi (D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j) all follow 1375-1446. The statement drops the hypothesis that q is a fixed odd prime avoiding the denominators of a fixed finite collection of matrices (1396-1397, 1413-1423). Without it the shear over Z/q^b is not defined for an arbitrary rational A.

The plan gives the cyclic row split into W role streams of volume V/W, Phi_{A_e} on each edge by recursive matrix shears, the frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, merging to H<-H+D on every row, the three-shear interchange, exactly s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), the geometric sum to O(e^tau), and the fixed-tape depth-first schedule. This is the proof at 1491-1616.

High digits form a row field q^{2rho}>=W^k, padded to a multiple of W^k, the remaining width is split in base m with power-width calls summing to O(Ve^tau), binary ranges are padded to [q^e], and widths differing by one bit are handled. This matches 1649-1762.

Edge frame change as a product of C_{v_j}^{eps_j}, conjugation by P_M with the residual basis as the first columns of M, one child (C^{eps})^{tensor f} per slot, inverse children via (C^{-1})^{tensor f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, exactly s_c child calls giving C^{tensor e}, a fixed number of row additions, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D. This follows 1835-1940.

The parity-cycle analysis of the eight operations, the single whole-chunk cyclic shift per line, the guard-based bad set with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, the radix-sort repair, the last selected position and the cost are all given. Two steps are missing. One is the argument that T_0 preserves B, so S_0(B)=B and T_0 S_0^{-1} permutes only B (2107-2114), which makes the extract-and-reinsert repair a valid permutation. The other is that each rotation is done by chunk swaps moving the target after its controls (2117-2155), which is where the L^tau movement cost comes from.

Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), the row split u=Wg+w with child volume V/W, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with F(e)=O(e) below d^beta, and the base-m sum to O(d^{lambda'}) are stated. Rows come only from 'the first few chunks' (no q_0=ceil(log_2 W) ceil(log_m 2d), no padding to a multiple of W^{k_0}). The step that bounds the overhead by O(e^lambda), using K<=d^c<=e^{c/beta} and tau(1+c/beta)<lambda (2394-2415), is absent. S3.4.5 sums internal costs to O(e^lambda) using only a<=m^sigma<m^lambda.

The statement (H_0 on one selected bit in each of D<=d chunks, O(Vd^{lambda'}), one truncation, error <sqrt2 2^{-p}) and the composite route (phase-frame recursion, packed basis changes, recurrence, conversion to H_0, truncation) are right. The guard-width bound ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p) is only asserted in S3.5. Its derivation (at most 12W gates, E bounding per-invocation arithmetic depth, A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, A(e)<=8dB^{k+1}, 2479-2560) is missing.

Character cancellation without dividing, the DIF recursion with bit-reversed storage giving B_t F_t^- and F_t^+ B_t^{-1}, grouping of axis steps into H then J_E, the layout L (prefix moves, at most Dq-1 chunk exchanges), the layer per round, signed-shift twiddles, error sqrt2 l 2^{-p} and the operators L B F^- and F^+ B^{-1} L^{-1}. This follows the paper's proofs.

Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, four signed products with the established multiplier, separation |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, centred extraction with carry in {0,1}, negacyclic wrap, truncation and the O(rp log(rp)) cost all follow 3233-3368.

Retained LB order, signed-packed pointwise products, the opposite transform and exact scale by M. The normalization comes from the convolution theorem with F^+F^-=I/M, and the error 2delta+eta then 3delta+eta, times M, gives sqrt2 M(3l+1)2^{-p}. The cost is as in the paper.

P_s F_s=2^{2alpha^2} B_0 P_t F_t A with (P_s u)_j=u_{tj}, (P_t v)_k=v_{-sk}, the Gaussian identity and Neumann inverse, normalizations S', J', D', error <p^2 and time O(tp^{3/2+delta} alpha), the retained permutations, the tensor form with gamma=2d alpha^2, and the axis exposure cost O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)). This follows 3576-3897.

Chirp periodicity for even t_i, coefficient comparison giving QF_t u=conj(a).(a*(conj(a).u))/T, F_q^+R_c=R_c^{-1}F_q^+, R F^+ R=F^+, and the two normalizations giving (u*v)/S^2. Conjugation for the opposite sign appears in S6.5.5. This is the proof at 3938-3988.

Fixed rationals, the size parameters b, p, d, K, T, r with t_i in {r/2,r}, prime intervals with eta=1/(4d) from HvdH Lemma 5.1, disjointness, T/2<S<T by Bernoulli, alpha^4 theta_i>p, and the n^{o(1)} deterministic search all match 4103-4175. The exact alpha=ceil((12d^2 b)^{1/4}) is used only implicitly.

Algebra map x -> prod x_i^{mu_i}, bijection on monomials, the triangular formula b_i=a_i+mu_i sum_{j<i} a_j P_j, updates in order i=d..1 preserving padding, prefix-controlled cyclic shifts, and the O(Tp d^2(1+l^tau)) cost. This matches 4204-4296.

Well-definedness (zeta y)^r=1, diagonal isometric isomorphism, wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, and the computed sequence twist/ring convolution/untwist with phase-product errors below 4h_p. This follows 4298-4413.

The source transform (A, chirp transform, B_0, scale 2^gamma) with exact counterpart RF_s, its conjugate, and the algorithm (Phi, two source transforms, pointwise product, opposite transform, scales S and 2^{2b+4}S, rounding, carries) are given. The two occurrences of S are explained. The input scaling of digits by 2^{-b-2} (4495-4499) is not stated, and Phi^{-1} before the carries (4528-4529) is never mentioned.

The error chain E_ring=M(3L+2)<5TL, chirp <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, (2E_s+2), (3E_s+2), E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28*2^gamma T^2 L, the final 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, rounding, carries and the 2n-bit output all follow the paper. S6.7.2 omits the operand-norm hypothesis (listed under errors).

Cost table rows and powers, margins g_1..g_7 with min g_2=epsilon c(1-tau)=2^{-181}=2kappa, absorption of fixed powers of log p, O(Tp p^{1-kappa})=O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}), and the schoolbook cutoff. This matches 4808-4995.

S0.1 states the eventual lower bound, its negation by one machine with liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0, and the stronger limit zero. The paper gives this only in the introduction, so there is no derivation to compare.

errors.says: Three such invocations (of the eight-row forward schedule) exchange the two banks as (X_a,Y_a) -> (-Y_a,X_a).
errors.paper: The exchange uses a forward invocation X->Y at stage 1, the inverse forward schedule Y->X at stage 2 (effecting X<-X-Y), and a forward invocation X->Y at stage 3. Each stage consists of v^2 invocations. S1.1.5 states this correctly.

errors.says: <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1 for triple indicators, so neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal in the label field of either construction.
errors.paper: |S cap T|-1 is the pairing of the rational form x^T(I-J/9)y on Q^h used for the bit network. The complex network's binary labels use F_2^h with the ordinary dot product (t_T.t_T=1, pairing |S cap T| mod 2), under which its even-intersection neighbours are orthogonal.

errors.says: For a rational matrix A of rank a, the shear (H,D)->(H+AD,D) over Z/q^bZ is performed with exactly a interchanges plus O(V).
errors.paper: The lemma is for a fixed finite collection of rational matrices and a fixed odd prime q chosen to avoid every denominator in their factor tables and every numerator of an invertible factor's diagonal entry. Only then do the rational identities specialize to Z/q^b.

errors.says: The second scale 2^{2b+4}S undoes the input scales and the remaining S, giving the original integer coefficient convolution.
errors.paper: The second scale gives 2^{2b+4}(u*v) in tensor order, whose inverse image under Phi is the original integer coefficient convolution. Phi^{-1} is applied after rounding in step 5.

errors.says: The normalized ring convolution has error below E_ring=M(3L+2)<5TL and its output has norm below .701.
errors.paper: The .701 norm bound requires one operand to have norm at most .7. The bilinear contraction then gives norm <=.7, and the error adds 5TLh_p.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route end to end: finite networks with s<Wm (S1), the fast interchange and its recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) (S2), the simultaneous butterfly layer on the complex network (S3), synthetic transforms and ring convolution (S4), resampling with retained permutations and the chirp identity (S5), assembly and exact recovery (S6), and the cost table with min margin 2kappa (S7). It thins out in the complex-network branch. The phase-frame interface is restated rather than derived (no weight-additivity/Hadamard step), the guard-width depth recurrence is only asserted, and the layer recurrence skips the K<=e^{c/beta}, tau(1+c/beta)<lambda step that bounds node overhead by e^lambda. In the label construction the gate-label table and central-gate labels are only referenced, and the network constants h=100, N, m=h^3 are never given.

steps.note: Borderline, and I chose the conservative verdict. The bank exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored is fully present (S1.1, S1.1.5), and the triple indexing is implicit in u_a=t_{a1} tensor t_{a2} tensor t_{a3}. But the plan never gives h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 or m=h^3 (653-657), which the step must carry and on which the later ratios depend.

A common invertible frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and each edge only changes frame by D_v D_u^{-1}. All of this is stated with the invariant argument.

Nondegenerate labels in F^{tensor 3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and the central 3->4 edges as the only decreases, each losing h (removing P tensor F tensor Q). The gate-label table itself is only referenced.
P_V-P_U is the identity on V cap U^perp with rank dim V-dim U. The N source edges are the exceptions, each of rank one (first edge matrix 2P_{U_a}).
Sum of |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, from telescoping and terminal sums, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b after adding the N source ranks.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2. The deficit N-2L_b>0 gives s_b<W_b m, and s_c<W_c m is stated as well.

M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a} for X_a; zero source and identity sink otherwise). Through Phi_{I_m}, the network applies H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included.
A=E_1 Pi E_2, triangular parts in O(V), one interchange per one of Pi so exactly a interchanges, and s recursive calls per node in total.

Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20 via m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta), giving F_k=O(e^tau). The exact eta values are not given.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely. Frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the strict saving from L/N<1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50} (C2-C9) all appear with their defining content and in their roles. Only C1 falls short: the exchange network and its scratch restoration are there, but the defining constants h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 are never stated.
